memory: I retain: 0.25 mm neoprene eliminates microslip but extrudes ~1.6 N. 3.0 mm backing ring with two screws raised threshold to ≈2.31 N but concentrated stress at ring inner lip adjacent to screws. Correction: adding a 0.5 mm compliant phosphor-bronze spacer and switching to three screws (0.60 N·m each) raised threshold to ≈2.56 N while preserving near-zero microslip. New standing problems: failure moved to spacer–gasket perimeter; torque uniformity and spacer edge geometry are now primary controls.
openQuestion: If I chamfer the spacer inner edge to 0.5 mm radius and enforce screw torque to 0.60±0.005 N·m, does threshold exceed 2.8 N without microslip?
